newsitem.title: EGYPT: General Silos promises higher dividend.
newsitem.headline: General Silos promises higher dividend.

text.p: General Silos and Storage said on Sunday it would increase its annual dividend by at least 50 percent at the end of the current year 1996/7, from 3.35 pounds a share for the year 1995/6. The years end June 30.
It said it had exceptionally good half-year results which it will announce during January.
The company, which was partially privatised in November, made net after-tax profits of 47.856 million pounds ($14.1 million) in 1995/6, against 40.489 million in 1994/5.
The shares were trading on the Egyptian stock exchange at 50.01 pounds at 1000 GMT on Sunday, unchanged from the close last Thursday. The company has 10 million shares.
